markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only, and the second model and 4 of 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign <1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 72nd percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical, but spot check failed 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; spot check 20/20 · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; weakly pulls toward non-invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60). It is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), which includes 0, so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules [F3] and mitoses [F4] are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) shifts embeddings in ways the reliability score misses.
- The reliability score only modestly ranks errors (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 5** — Confirm benign gland architecture with intact two-layered epithelium.
2. **Region 8** — Highest tumor-infiltrating-stroma score; confirm the stroma is not infiltrated.
3. **Regions 7, 8, 9** — Lobule concept failed its spot check; assess lobules directly.
